title: Relay mailbox receipt ACK with the exact listed mailboxId returns 409 "no saved native mailbox association for this exact mailboxId and caller"
outcome: Native relay read, acknowledgement and exact message read give the same specific refusal when a well-formed locator matches none of the caller's mailboxes. Both participant cursors and issued receipts are preserved.
acceptance: When an authorized lookup establishes that a well-formed native relay locator matches no mailbox or message visible to the caller, read, acknowledgement and exact message read return the same HTTP 404 refusal. It says that the locator does not match any of the caller's mailboxes.

The unknown-locator refusal leaves both cursors and any previously issued receipt intact. Valid locators retain their current behavior, and malformed locators, unavailable homes, home or store conflicts, and invalid receipts retain distinct refusals.

A behavioral test creates a Central-homed native relay mailbox shared with an enrolled satellite participant, changes the UUID tail in the mailbox locator for read and acknowledgement and in the message locator for exact message read, and verifies the same refusal and unchanged cursors. The original locators and unchanged issued receipt still work. The test asserts the refusal's status and typed reason, not its prose; no text-pinning test.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.

completion.summary: Landed the uniform typed 404 for authorized unknown native relay locators on page read, receipt acknowledgement, and exact message read, preserving original receipts and both cursors. All four acceptance criteria passed independently on clean 8fcc0fbd.
